name: kratosforge-powerbi-client
description: Microsoft's powerbi-client SDK for the Power BI embed host frame (embed-host/host.html, PBE-03). powerbi.min.js is dist/powerbi.min.js from the npm tarball below, unchanged (it carries Microsoft's own signature block). To update: npm pack powerbi-client@<version>, check the tarball against `npm view powerbi-client@<version> dist.integrity`, copy dist/powerbi.min.js, LICENSE.txt and dist/powerbi.js.LICENSE.min.txt here, and update these fields and POWERBI_CLIENT_SHA256 in app/tests/browser/embed-host.test.cjs.
